Statement: Multi-class (4-13 classes) YOLO and transformer 2D OPG object detectors already exist across multiple clinical cohorts (13/23 Group A papers), refuting any broad claim that multi-class OPG detection does not exist.
Scope: Screened 122-study corpus (42 Core extracted full-text + 55 Reserve incl. 27 YOLO); tests GAP0001 / G1
Contradictions: Single-condition Core detectors also exist (P0003, P0004, P0008, P0012, P0013, P0018, P0029, P0033, P0035, P0036, P0041); shared cohorts (UMFIH, Tufts) reduce independent count.
Uncertainty: Low for existence of multi-class detectors; some inflated via pre-split leakage (P0006, P0021, P0025).
Verification: Verified directly against T05 summaries and GAP0001.md (STEP-008)

Statement: Multi-class 2D OPG detectors achieve 0.83-0.98 mAP50 on high-contrast/large targets (Impacted teeth, Implants, Crowns) yet collapse on small radiolucent pathologies (Periapical 0.07-0.32, Caries 0.25-0.40), diffuse bone loss (0.15-0.17), and rare classes (Supernumerary 0.00-0.58).
Scope: Multi-class and surface-stratified OPG detectors (2023-2026); surviving narrowed gap under G1 / UD04
Contradictions: P0001 subset-only YOLO26m got mAP50 0.87-0.91 on cysts/granulomas (n=14-16); P0016 merged caries+fillings (p.4); P0024 omitted minority per-class AP.
Uncertainty: Moderate across varying taxonomies and test sizes; qualitative radiographic contrast pattern is robust.
Verification: Verified directly against T05 summaries and GAP0001.md (STEP-008)

Statement: Multiple studies conflate whole-image, sliding-patch, Grad-CAM, or closed-set confusion classifiers with spatial object detection (P0002, P0010, P0017, P0021, P0031, P0034, P0036, P0038), while tight tooth-crop pipelines truncate periapical lesions (P0032 Sens 0.538 vs 0.854).
Scope: Task classification vs spatial box localization across 42 Core papers; tests GAP0002 / G2
Contradictions: 23 Group A studies + 5 Group B box detectors (P0026, P0030, P0032, P0036, P0041) DO perform spatial box localization.
Uncertainty: Low: every task mismatch is directly observed in T05 primary tables and methods.
Verification: Verified directly against T05 summaries and GAP0002.md (STEP-008)

Statement: Systematic review P0027 (73 YOLO dental studies) finds 84.9% (62/73) omit mAP@0.5:0.95 and 87.7% (64/73) lack external validation; omitting strict IoU thresholds masks box-alignment collapse such as P0019 Tooth 71 (mAP50=0.995 vs mAP50-95=0.0995).
Scope: Pre-Aug-2025 dental YOLO review P0027 + Core Group A metric audit; tests GAP0002 / G2
SourceLocators: P0027 Tables 2-3 (pp.9-23); P0019 Table 1 (p.9); Group A T05 metric audits
Contradictions: 12/23 Group A (2024-2026) studies do report mAP50-95, and P0015/P0016/P0023/P0029/P0030 include external validation (P0027 cutoff/filter missed late-2025/CS papers).
Uncertainty: Low for P0027 exact corpus statistics and P0019 Tooth 71 values.
Verification: Verified directly against P0027.md, P0019.md, and GAP0002.md (STEP-008)

Statement: Bounding-box detection beats semantic segmentation on discrete multi-instance screening over identical 407 OPGs (P0018 F1=96.0%, mAP50=98.3% vs P0035 F1=92.02%, IoU=85.29%) and mixed/multi-class teeth (P0007, P0022), while AABBs alone underperform keypoints (P0013), OBBs (P0006, P0026), and diffuse contours (P0023).
Scope: Representation suitability across boxes, OBBs, keypoints, and masks; tests GAP0003 / G3 & scope.md
Contradictions: Instance tooth-seg reaches 0.94-0.98 mDice/mAP50 (P0001, P0011, P0015, P0040) for boundary charting when needed, though cascading masks clips 9.7% of lesions (P0011).
Uncertainty: Low for comparative findings; P0018 omitted mAP50-95 and used small 21-OPG validation set.
Verification: Verified directly against T05 summaries and GAP0003.md (STEP-008)

Statement: 2D OPG has physical visibility ceilings vs 3D CBCT (P0039 paired Diagnocat OPG Sens=33.33% vs CBCT 77.78%; P0034 4/6 CBCT GT) and intraoral BW/PA (P0032 initial enamel caries excluded; P0036 8 OPG mimics), rendering cross-modality numeric ranking invalid (P0002, P0021, P0027).
Scope: Modality boundaries governing scope.md (2D OPG only; no CBCT modeling or cross-modality ranking); GAP0004 / G4
SourceLocators: P0039 Polish paired OPG+CBCT cohort (49 patients, 1,223 teeth); P0034 p.15; P0032 Table 2, p.8; P0036 Fig. 7; P0002 p.4; P0021 Table 4 (p.11)
Contradictions: OPG outperforms intraoral on full-arch permanent FDI Acc (0.980 vs 0.956 in P0032), proving value as a full-arch screening modality rather than CBCT replacement.
Uncertainty: P0039 sample is small (49 patients, 26-27 lesions) with Table 1-4 mismatches; qualitative physical limit is corroborated across 6 studies.
Verification: Verified directly against T05 summaries and GAP0004.md (STEP-008)

Statement: Within 2D OPG, external cross-scanner and protocol domain shifts consistently degrade accuracy (-9.0% to -22.2% mAP50 in P0015, P0016, P0023; -10.26% IoU in P0029; bite-block tooth A hallucinations in P0030).
Scope: Within-OPG cross-center generalization; tests GAP0004 / G4 and guides S04/S08 validation
Contradictions: P0021 claimed 99.05% external Acc on [38] without drop, but [38] (Brahmi & Jdey 2023) is a 107-OPG binary tooth seg set lacking 6-class boxes.
Uncertainty: Low: every verified external 2D OPG test shows -9% to -22% drop (P0015 & P0023 share UMFIH cohorts).
Verification: Verified directly against T05 summaries and GAP0004.md (STEP-008)

Statement: CLAHE and contrast/SR enhancements are NOT universally beneficial in 2D OPG: controlled gain in P0004 (0.701/0.774 -> 0.948) is contradicted by drops/null gains in P0011 (-3.91% mAP50-95), P0029 (0.8173 raw > 0.8104-0.8151), P0038 (95.69% < 97.50%), P0018 (-1.9%), P0041, P0001, and P0008.
Scope: Empirical effect of CLAHE/enhancement on OPG detection & seg; tests GAP0005 / G5 and motivates O2 S7 ablation
Contradictions: P0004 showed strong YOLOv5 gains on cropped IMC (+0.174 mAP50 over crop); P0002 (+1.3% F1) bundled ROI+CLAHE on pre-split RGB images.
Uncertainty: High uncertainty predicting benefit a priori on a new OPG cohort; therefore CLAHE parameters must be ablated empirically vs Raw in S7.
Verification: Verified directly against T05 summaries and GAP0005.md (STEP-008)

Statement: Native-resolution tiling (P0008 +0.039 to +0.121 mAP50 + mandatory background tiles; P0028 Rohrer +294% RCTs) and higher input scale (1280-1600px in P0011, P0015, P0017) improve small-target detection more reliably than contrast filters, while 75% central cropping deletes 5.7% of GT boxes (P0015).
Scope: Spatial resolution, tiling, and cropping trade-offs in 2D OPG; tests GAP0005 / G5 & O2-O3
Contradictions: Dense multi-tile scanning slows P0008 to 2.38 OPG/s on RTX 4090, and high input resolution increases VRAM/latency (O3 trade-off).
Uncertainty: Low regarding small-lesion downsampling compression at 512-640px; optimal resolution vs speed is task-dependent.
Verification: Verified directly against T05 summaries and GAP0005.md (STEP-008)

Statement: Pre-split augmentation, train-in-test contamination, and metric math errors severely inflate OPG benchmarks — demonstrated by +30.4% mAP50 inflation between pre-augmented P0011 (0.9194) and deduplicated P0008 (0.494-0.615) on identical Do (2024) data, plus P0002, P0006, P0014, P0016, P0020-P0022, P0025, P0033, P0036, P0040.
Scope: Data hygiene & deterministic evaluation standards across S04/STEP-010 and Phase 2; tests GAP0005 / G5
Contradictions: Exemplary leak-free splits are demonstrated in P0008 (deduplicated), P0003 (patient-level), P0012 (1 OPG/patient), and P0032 (242-patient holdout).
Uncertainty: Low: directly established from explicit source split/table records and arithmetic verification.
Verification: Verified directly against T05 summaries and GAP0005.md (STEP-008)

Statement: 73.8% (31/42) of Core OPG studies (14/23 Group A + 17/19 Group B) omit per-image inference latency (ms/FPS), including 6 studies making unverified 'real-time' or speed claims (P0005, P0017, P0018, P0019, P0033, P0035), while P0009 omits its own defined FPS_all (T_pre+T_post).
Scope: Audit of latency & hardware reporting across all 42 Core studies; tests GAP0006 / G6
SourceLocators: T05 Timing/Hardware sections across P0001.md-P0042.md; P0009 Eqs. 13-14 & Table 4 (pp.13-14); GAP0006.md
Contradictions: 10 Core studies report GPU/workstation OPG runtime (P0006, P0008, P0009, P0011, P0012, P0013 coarse <500ms, P0015, P0020, P0029, P0041) plus P0001 cloud E2E (15s).
Uncertainty: Low: exact census directly audited across all 42 extracted T05 summaries.
Verification: Verified directly against P0001.md-P0042.md and GAP0006.md (STEP-008)

Statement: While raw single-stage YOLO GPU passes exceed 30 FPS (P0006, P0009, P0012, P0015, P0020), high-recall tiled/cascaded/CPU pipelines drop to 0.30-6.29 OPG/s (P0008, P0011, P0029, P0001), leaving same-hardware leak-free mAP@0.5:0.95 + bounded E2E timing (T_pre+T_infer+T_post) open for O3.
Scope: Contribution hypothesis guiding Phase 2 O3 benchmarking (accuracy vs CPU+GPU E2E speed) & S16 demo; tests GAP0006 / G6
Contradictions: P0015 YOLO11m reached 30.1 FPS GPU / 25.0 FPS CPU at 1024px, but lost -20.5% mAP50 externally and lacked per-class breakdowns/sub-timings.
Uncertainty: Hardware heterogeneity (T4 to RTX 5060 / 4xV100) prevents direct cross-paper speed ranking; requires single-rig Phase 2 experiments.
Verification: Narrowed hypothesis verified from T05 runtime audits (STEP-008); empirical benchmark awaits Phase 2 S05-S14
